siteContent.heroBadge: A Philanthropic Initiative of Aryan Medical & Educational Trust
siteContent.kushtiText: Shri Ghanshyam Dube's foundational character was sculpted in the traditional clay wrestling arenas of Maharashtra. The akhada was not merely sport-it was a moral sanctuary cultivating physical fortitude, deep reverence for peers, and the duty to shield those who cannot defend themselves.
siteContent.heroTagline: Honouring a Legacy. Inspiring Generations. Creating a Future of Possibilities.
siteContent.featuredVideoDesc: The central archival film chronicling the earthen wrestling discipline, legislative leadership in Maharashtra, and the decadal vision behind GRD Nationals - A Philanthropic Initiative of Aryan Medical & Educational Trust.
siteContent.publicServiceText: Through decades of civic advocacy in Mumbai and across Maharashtra, Shri Ghanshyamji was known as the leader who arrived before dawn and left after the last citizen was heard. He refused self-promotional plaques, believing that enduring work leaves its own quiet testimony.
siteContent.featuredVideoTitle: The Living Legacy of Shri Ghanshyam Raj Narayan Dube
